title: Complete player, study, interrupted and library sessions
steps: Start at Home with no games or saves; the three scripted profiles and normal session/autosave settings are installed.
First player: create a custom timed game with both analysis engines, play e4 d5 exd5, explore and return, continue with c6, save, reload/load the named snapshot, resume, resign and reopen the result.
Study: create free analysis, build nested alternatives, enter/leave editing without a change, relocate the visible a2 pawn to a3, start a timed game with a Black engine, export and import.
Interrupted: hold player output before e4, apply appearance in Settings, release the held reply while away, return once, let White time out, review and save/reload.
Library: create two games and named snapshots, compare latest and selected loads, export/import the same file twice, delete only Opening, reopen a recent game and retry a scoped named-write failure.
Use reset() or reopen with reset=1 to restore Home. Reload alone preserves files; engine/storage controls reset on bootstrap.
